about: What `dragonfly gen` writes on each platform (the [[generators]] of each platform.toml).

rows.title: `dragonfly gen component` on the backend platform: what it writes
rows.summary: The files `dragonfly gen component` writes in a backend project, finished and compiling: appcomponent.
body: Each piece is a file at its kind's place (`nuclear help layout --platform backend`); nothing is overwritten.
- appcomponent `{{Component}}AppComponent`, added to the file when it exists
The names: `{{Name}}` the resource, `{{Names}}` its plural, `{{Component}}` the component, `{{UseCase}}` one per action.

rows.title: `dragonfly gen resource` on the backend platform: what it writes
rows.summary: The files `dragonfly gen resource` writes in a backend project, finished and compiling: appcomponent, controller, entity, model, repository, tests, usecase.
body: Each piece is a file at its kind's place (`nuclear help layout --platform backend`); nothing is overwritten.
- model `{{Model}}` (when `rest`), one per `models`
- entity `{{Name}}` (when `db`)
- model `New{{Name}}` (when `db`)
- repository `{{Name}}Repository` (when `rest`), added to the file when it exists
- repository `{{Name}}Repository` (when `db`), added to the file when it exists
- usecase `{{UseCase}}`, one per `each_action`
- appcomponent `{{Component}}AppComponent`, added to the file when it exists
- controller `{{Names}}Controller`, added to the file when it exists
- tests `{{Names}}Test` (when `db`)
The names: `{{Name}}` the resource, `{{Names}}` its plural, `{{Component}}` the component, `{{UseCase}}` one per action.

body: Each piece is a file at its kind's place (`nuclear help layout --platform backend`); nothing is overwritten.
- usecase `{{UseCase}}` (when `result`)
- usecase `{{UseCase}}` (when `plain`)
